grammar.summary: 本课记述考古发现，大量使用被动语态叙述「被发现、被修建、被保护」的客观事实，并用 must have been 对古城与文物作过去的肯定推测；同时以 which/who 引导的定语从句补充说明庙宇、长裙等对象。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: be + 过去分词构成被动语态，突出动作的承受者或客观结果，常用于考古、科学叙述。本课频繁用被动描述「发现、修建、保护」等动作，主语多为遗迹与文物本身，叙述更显客观。

examples.en: an interesting discovery was made by archaeologists on the Aegean island of Kea.
examples.cn: 在爱琴海的基亚岛上，考古工作者有一项有趣的发现。

examples.en: Houses -- often three storeys high -- were built of stone.
examples.cn: 房子一般有3层楼高，用石块修建。

examples.en: This head must have been found in Classical times and carefully preserved.
examples.cn: 她的脑袋一定是在古希腊罗马时代就为人所发现，并受到精心的保护。

points.title: must have been 过去推测 (Past Deduction)
points.explanation: must have been + 过去分词/形容词，表示对过去事实的肯定推测，意为「一定曾……」。本课据城市文明程度推测「古城肯定一度很繁荣」，又据头颅被精心保护推测「一定是在古典时代被发现并保护下来」。

examples.en: The city at one time must have been prosperous, for it enjoyed a high level of civilization.
examples.cn: 这座古城肯定一度很繁荣，因为它曾享有高度的文明。

examples.en: This head must have been found in Classical times and carefully preserved.
examples.cn: 她的脑袋一定是在古希腊罗马时代就为人所发现，并受到精心的保护。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 which/that 引导定语从句修饰事物先行词，补充信息。本课用 which stands in an ancient city 修饰 temple，用 which swept the ground 修饰 skirt，使长句层次分明、信息紧凑。

examples.en: An American team explored a temple which stands in an ancient city on the promontory of Ayia Irini.
examples.cn: 一个美国考古队在阿伊亚.依里尼海角的一座古城里考察了一座庙宇。

examples.en: She was wearing a full-length skirt which swept the ground.

exercises.q: an interesting discovery ______ by archaeologists on the Aegean island of Kea.
The city at one time ______ prosperous, for it enjoyed a high level of civilization.
An American team explored a temple ______ stands in an ancient city on the promontory of Ayia Irini.
用被动语态填空：Houses -- often three storeys high -- ______ (build) of stone.（写出 build 的正确形式）
